_source: Copied from amberhq/fix-it-felix slack-bot/app.py (ROUTE_GROUP_MAP and the route_to rules in the system prompt), commit 7c41faa. Keep in sync with Felix.

pod1.label: Website team
pod1.owns: Website and student-facing amberstudent.com pages: search, property and listing pages, booking and payment flow.

pod2.label: CRM & dialer team
pod2.owns: CRM, leads, agent tools, dialer, calls and telephony, attribution and lead data.

pod3.label: Partner & whitelabel team
pod3.owns: Partner dashboard, whitelabel / flex dashboard, sub-partners, *.studentacco.com.

podAI.label: AI team
podAI.owns: AI product and platform (not AI calling): chatbot / Copilot.

podPLG.label: PLG team
podPLG.owns: Product-led growth and self-serve surfaces: referrals, Amber+, pre-arrival and post-booking journeys.

qa.label: QA (supply & content)
qa.owns: Felix's interim owner for supply and content requests until a supply team exists.

none.label: No tech owner
none.owns: Research, marketing, sales-process and partnership-deal items. Like Felix, nobody is tagged rather than guessing; reassign it if a pod should own it.
